lines.text: David gives thanks with all his heart and bows down toward God's holy temple.
David gives thanks to God's name for His power and His faithfulness.
On the day David called, God answered him and strengthened his soul.
All the kings of the earth will give thanks to the LORD when they doubt the words of His mouth.
Though the LORD is on high, He attends to the lowly, and the proud He knows from afar.
